operation.summary: Home inventory from a photo: every belonging in it with a box, category, brand and model where they can be read, visible condition, estimated price new and used (US dollars), whether a home or renters policy would normally cover it, and how sure the model is. One cloud vision call (about half a cent; shares the Jev/Clef budget)

body.name: capture_id
body.description: A photo this agent captured and kept (POST /v1/camera/snapshot with store), or one shared with it

body.name: gallery_id
body.description: An accessible gallery photo (also needs the gallery grant)

body.name: data_base64
body.description: The image bytes instead (JPEG, PNG or WebP; about 1.5 MB of image at most, so use capture_id or gallery_id for big photos)

body.name: room
body.description: Optional: the room the photo is in, e.g. Kitchen (60 characters at most); otherwise the model guesses

operation.returns: room, items [{label, category, brand, model, quantity, condition new|like new|good|fair|poor, new_usd, used_usd, insurable, insurable_note, confidence 0-1, box {x0,y0,x1,y1 fractions, px}}], count, currency USD, estimate_basis, model, cost_usd, width_px, height_px. Prices are model estimates, not quotes; brand/model/condition/prices may be null

data_base64.description: The image bytes instead (JPEG, PNG or WebP; about 1.5 MB of image at most, so use capture_id or gallery_id for big photos)

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice

gallery_id.description: An accessible gallery photo (also needs the gallery grant)

capture_id.description: A photo this agent captured and kept (POST /v1/camera/snapshot with store), or one shared with it

room.description: Optional: the room the photo is in, e.g. Kitchen (60 characters at most); otherwise the model guesses
